description: Get a summary of results for a Wellemo knowledge test: number of participants, average score, pass rate, average time and the questions people got wrong most often. Needs the private edit_url (or its id) returned by create_knowledge_test. Participant names are not returned; full results are at results_url.

edit_url.description: The private edit_url of the test (or the id from it).

name: get_test_results
title: Get test results
